{{Quote|By the style of their camp, I would say they are Yiwa of the Qiemo Adrangar. Not an unimportant clan, such as the Eijin or Gaxun, but not an overclan like the Borokii or the Januul, either.|Kyakhta|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''Yiwa''' were an [[Alwari]] clan that were part of the [[Qiemo Adrangar]] tribal faction on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Their leader<ref name="AS" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] was [[Highborn]] [[Mazong]]. The Yiwa, though a lesser clan of the Alwari was not an unimportant one. Its members were known for their wariness of strangers, their quickness to take offense, and for always being on the move. They traveled on [[sadain]] mounts, which were also used as beasts of burden, and kept domesticated, corralled [[dorgum]] and heavy-humped [[awiquod]].

In 22 BBY, during their [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], a team of four Jedi—[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]—performed at an evening feast at a temporary Yiwa camp that had been set up at the end of a shallow, reed-filled lake. The Yiwa were so impressed by the Jedi's performances that they agreed to aid them in their mission to find and negotiate with the [[Borokii]] [[overclan]], in a bid to prevent Ansion's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AS" />
